title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction; layouts and live previews may contain errors.

Target information: each row of the card is on its own line again (Gameface had joined them into one line). The former card returns as the Classic preset, now the default: vehicle picture, reload with equipment and aligned armour and shell tables, with labels in every language. Profiles that still had that card unchanged switch to Classic automatically; edited cards and the other presets are kept.
Shell types: the target card shows AP, APCR, HE, HEAT and HESH in all 18 languages instead of machine-translated words.
Frontline: player statistics now appear on the loading screen and in the TAB; the mod did not recognise the Frontline tables, so nothing was shown.
Settings panel: new header image and a GitHub button that opens the project repository.
Sixth Sense: a '%' in the spotted text no longer breaks the alert, and the first alert of a new battle is no longer skipped.
Battle marks: the card can only be dragged while it and the cursor are visible, like the other cards. Target and player weights keep their decimal.
Interface: Gameface no longer logs warnings for unsupported CSS or unloaded fonts; the clock, tech-tree marks, crew details and health bar use the game's Warhelios font.

Logs: game.log names the Driftkings and game versions at startup and no longer repeats the [LEVEL][Driftkings][module] prefix. The updater and the account manager now log why an operation failed; account messages contain only the error type, never e-mail addresses or passwords.
Compatibility: Python 2.7 and World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Signed beta release; tested on the EU client.
